sentences.text:
Misc. Criminal Case No. 14080 of 2025
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Versus
 Smt Farida Begam Biswas
Ms Anjali Gyanani - Public Prosecutor for State.

Shri Yashwant Rao Dixit - Advocate for respondent.
 ORDER

The present application has been filed by the complainant under Section 483(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking cancellation of bail granted in favour of the respondent/accused by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 20.01.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 53698/2024, in connection with Crime No. 622/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Bhind for offences punishable under Sections 420, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Today, this Court in connected M.Cr.C. No. 15148/2025 has already quashed the FIR bearing Crime No. 622/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Bhind for the aforesaid offences on the basis of compromise arrived at between the complainant and the accused persons.
In view of the quashment of the FIR itself, the very substratum of the present application seeking cancellation of bail no longer survives.
The application, therefore, has rendered infructuous.
Accordingly, the present application stands dismissed as infructuous.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:369 2 MCRC-14080-2025 ojha The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Smt Farida Begam Biswas on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111132641/
